description: Search the data catalog: which dataset's values answer a question about weather and the people and places it affects, or what data exists at a point. With `query` it ranks datasets and map layers and returns hits with the next `call` (a named place fills its `area`; add a place if `note` asks) and any verified `example`; without it, it lists datasets at the place with freshness, or all. A place or `domain` keeps datasets covering it; `kind` and `family` filter a listing, rank a query; describe_data lists other variables for get_data. Example: {"query": "snow depth", "location": "Erie, PA"}.

domain.description: Coverage filter without a place; global = no filter.

kind.description: grid: forecasts (incl. AQ, UV, HeatRisk, radar nowcast), normals, astronomy, observed daily extremes; snapshot: latest radar mosaics, satellite, analyses, AQ, soil moisture; feature: station obs and normals, soundings, recon, lightning flashes, radar cell detections, reports, alerts, outlooks, places; text: forecaster text; index: climate indices, SSW.

limit.description: Rows (1-10); default 5 with query, all without.

location.description: "City, ST", ZIP or "lat,lon" (up to 200 chars); not with lat/lon.

query.description: The question in the user's words (2-200 chars); omit to list.

name: search_data

data_status.description: Listing at a place: present only when the data service did not provide freshness, or answered from a cached copy.

domain.description: The coverage filter applied: the place's domain, or `domain`.

call.description: The exact call that answers from this dataset; through call_tool when that tool is not on this connection.

connect.description: With `toolset`: the path that serves this connection's toolsets plus that one, e.g. /x/core,catalog,guidance.

domain.description: Listing rows: the dataset's domain when not the place's.

example.description: A verified get_data call on this dataset for a question like this one, verbatim: adapt its place and times.

map.description: The render (visual) call that draws this dataset's map beside a call that reads it; when this connection does not list it, through call_tool with `toolset` and `connect` as for `call`.

toolset.description: When this connection does not list that tool: its toolset.

variable.description: The standard variable the call reads; absent when it reads several (an index `*` call lists `variables`).

variables.description: index: every variable the call reads (standard names).

why.description: With query: why this dataset ranked.

title: Search data
